messages:
ciara-finance: heads up — HelioThera invoice INV-9900 ($18,200) declined with code 'issuer_hold'. Customer says their bank put a temporary hold because of unusual amount. they can pay today if we provide alternative rails.

ben-sales: ouch. any gateway details? last4?

ciara-finance: gw_tx: gw_f3d9, last4: 1111. No 3DS flagged.

billing-bot: Auto-retry scheduled per policy: 3 attempts over 48h. Next attempt in 3h (2001235667).

paygate-sys: issuer_hold often resolves after cardholder confirms with their bank. Options: (1) wait for customer to clear with bank and let retries run, (2) provide wire instructions, (3) issue a secure paylink for card entry from treasury, or (4) accept a one-time virtual card token if customer can request from their TMS.

mira-ops: For amounts >$15k we need finance lead sign-off to accept wire/virtual-card. pinging @sam-compliance for sanctions/KYC re-check.

ben-sales: customer is ok with wire or virtual card but treasury prefers RTP (same-day ACH) if we support it. Do we?

ciara-finance: we don't currently accept customer-initiated RTP pushes into our account without preboarding their bank (risk). Wire is the supported bank-to-bank method for same-day settlement.

sam-compliance: quick lookup: HelioThera (MID HT-314) passed initial KYC, no sanctions flags. Approve one-time wire or virtual-card flow with standard reconciliation holds.

mira-ops: finance lead approval granted by @ciara-finance (thread note). I'll pause automatic retries while customer moves funds to avoid duplicate collects.

ciara-finance: Pasting redacted wire template (share externally only via secure channel):

```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank: Northbridge Bank, N.A.
SWIFT: NBRDUS33
Routing (ACH): 011000015
Account: ****9012
Reference: INV-9900 / HelioThera
```

ben-sales: sending to customer now. I'll ask treasury if they can issue a one-time virtual card instead — they use a TMS that can create single-use PANs.

paygate-sys: Note: if customer provides virtual-card token we must capture via our gateway and flag for 48h reconciliation. Also re-enable retries if virtual-card attempt fails.

billing-bot: Payment workflow update: retries paused -> awaiting_customer_fund.

ben-sales: customer replied: treasury can generate single-use virtual card now. they asked what details we need (expiry, cvc or token).

mira-ops: ask for tokenized PAN (preferred) or full PAN via secure paylink. Do not accept card details in chat. Also request a brief attestation from their treasury that it's authorized.

ciara-finance: agreed. If they send virtual card token, we will attempt immediate capture; if it fails, we'll fallback to wire per above. Keep ops posted.

sam-compliance: logged approval: one-time virtual card or wire accepted for INV-9900; standard holds and recon apply.

ciara-finance: closing interim loop — customer pursuing virtual-card token, ops paused retries. I'll update billing ticket with gw_tx and approvals. If nothing arrives by EOD PST, we'll re-enable retry schedule.
